tasks.final_text: My favorite food is cheesecake. I don't have a particular reason why cheesecake is my favorite food. I've always liked it. I especially like the ones with real berries on them. Actually, artificial-ish berries are fine too, but I like the fruit flavored cheesecakes more than alternatives. That isn't to say that a chocolate base isn't really good too.

The 1954 Atlantic hurricane season was an above-average Atlantic hurricane season in terms of named storms, with 16 forming. Overall, the season resulted in $751.6 million in damage, the most of any season at the time. The season officially began on June 15, and nine days later the first named storm developed.
